name: Kyugo Training
description: Kyugo Training — a block theme for a workplace first-aid training centre or vocational school. Two fixed white side rails frame a 1200px photo stage; the hero is a three-photo crossfade under an olive corner wash with a three-line white statement; a stacked-paper card stack tells the training day; dated notes, a wide parallax photo, a counted stat band, instructor portraits flush to the edges and a horizontal four-step booking line complete the home page. Hanken Grotesk and Schibsted Grotesk. Sample content in English. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; scroll effects respect reduced motion.

fonts.role: headings, the hero statement, numerals (variable 100-900, Latin subset)
